ledger.title: Phase 6 Coverage Ledger
notes: Sprint 0 activates the Phase 6 ownership map before feature work. Initial later-sprint rows are selectable placeholders until their owning behavior is implemented.

Phase 3 remains owner for server-side field-level patch rebase, same-field conflict transport, and collection conflict values. Phase 6 owns resolver, concurrent-client, and local pending-queue behavior.
authoritative_execution: `backend-unit` selects pure Phase 6 conflict, resolver-contract, and transport-domain rows through the Phase 6 manifest and `backend_unit` execution dependency.
`backend-store` selects service-backed Phase 6 workbook mutation and focused socket route-contract rows through manifest-owned service-backed selection.
`frontend-unit` selects Phase 6 workbook resolver, save-state, and pending-queue component rows through the Phase 6 manifest for `frontend_unit`.
`backend-integration` selects Phase 6 real-runtime WebSocket and concurrent-edit rows through the Phase 6 manifest and `backend_integration` execution dependency.

`browser-e2e-webserver-backed` carries authoritative functional `E-6-*` rows through duration-balanced Playwright manifest-entry shards under `browser_functional`; `browser-e2e-stateful` carries shared-clock session-expiry `E-6-*` rows under `browser_stateful`.
support_execution_extras: Existing Phase 1 and Phase 3 socket, revocation, autosave, and same-field conflict tests remain carryover support evidence and must not claim Phase 6 IDs.

`internal/modules/revisions/conflicttokens/conflict_token_test.go` keeps revisions-owned token codec compatibility coverage under `TestSupportPhase6_ConflictTokenCodec*`. The authoritative Phase 6 conflict claims remain the route-owned rows in `phase6_conflict_route_test.go`.

`internal/modules/workbook/phase6_shared_harness_test.go`, `internal/modules/collaboration/phase6_shared_harness_test.go`, `internal/modules/collaboration/phase6_integration_test.go`, and `internal/platform/ws/phase6_ws_test.go` are selected as Phase 6 support evidence for shared §14 inventory, socket lifecycle evidence indexing, real-socket revocation conformance, and low-level socket behavior.
shared_harness: | Machine-readable ownership | `shared_harnesses[]` records support-owned §14 harness coverage separately from authoritative Phase 6 row completion. |

| Workbook route conformance | `internal/modules/workbook/testsupport/phase6test.Phase6WorkbookRouteInventory()` enumerates Phase 6 workbook create, patch, and conflict-resolve route requirements; `internal/modules/workbook/phase6_shared_harness_test.go` probes envelope, authorization re-derivation, replay/divergent replay, closed vocabulary, writable-string normalization, field-key conformance, attribution, and replay-stability behavior through the real HTTP surface. |

| Incident WebSocket lifecycle | `internal/modules/workbook/testsupport/phase6test.Phase6SocketEventInventory()` is inventory only; `internal/modules/collaboration/phase6_shared_harness_test.go` asserts that the required lifecycle obligations map to behavior-level tests, while lifecycle conformance proof lives in `internal/modules/collaboration/phase6_socket_test.go`, `internal/modules/collaboration/phase6_integration_test.go`, `internal/platform/ws/phase6_ws_test.go`, and `internal/modules/collaboration/testsupport/incidentwstest`. Revocation-source conformance is supplemental support evidence and must not widen `I-6-01`. |

| Grid and browser-command anchors | `packages/test-utils/src/index.ts`, `packages/test-utils/src/index.test.ts`, `packages/grid-adapter/src/index.test.tsx`, `packages/ui-contracts/src/index.test.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/phase6.collaboration.spec.ts`, and `apps/web/e2e/workbook.visual.spec.ts` support current Phase 6 sort/filter/group/scroll/autosave command anchors and geometric marker anchoring; paste, fill-down, and group expand/collapse helpers are active FE-P3 support, while column resize remains support/design measurement unless an owner spec adopts it. |

| Workbook resolver helpers | `apps/web/src/workbook/WorkbookShell.phase6.test.tsx` holds Phase 6 resolver, save-state, and pending-queue component rows until the UI is split into smaller owner components. |
support_only: `internal/modules/auth/phase1_integration_test.go` keeps Phase 1 session revocation socket coverage as carryover support for Phase 6 implementation, but authoritative Phase 6 completion claims must live in `phase6_*` rows.

`internal/modules/timeline/phase3_integration_test.go` keeps Phase 3 canonical socket and same-field conflict transport coverage as carryover support for Phase 6 implementation, but authoritative Phase 6 completion claims must live in `phase6_*` rows.

`internal/modules/revisions/conflicttokens/conflict_token_test.go` keeps revisions-owned support coverage for conflict-token round trips, tamper rejection, and invalid-claim rejection. These tests run under `TestSupportPhase6_ConflictTokenCodec*` and do not replace `U-6-*` or `I-6-*` rows.

`internal/modules/workbook/phase6_shared_harness_test.go`, `internal/modules/collaboration/phase6_shared_harness_test.go`, `internal/modules/collaboration/phase6_integration_test.go::TestSupportPhase6_IncidentSocketRevocationSources`, and `internal/platform/ws/phase6_ws_test.go` are Phase 6 support evidence for shared harness inventory, socket lifecycle evidence indexing, real-socket revocation-source conformance, and low-level socket behavior; inventory-only rows must not claim `U-6-*` or `I-6-*` identifiers.

`internal/modules/workbook/workbook_mutation_integration_test.go` keeps existing workbook mutation conflict coverage as carryover support for Phase 6 implementation, but authoritative Phase 6 completion claims must live in `phase6_*` rows.

`apps/web/src/workbook/WorkbookShell.phase3.autosave.test.tsx` keeps Phase 3 autosave and conflict UI coverage as carryover support for Phase 6 implementation, but authoritative Phase 6 completion claims must live in `phase6_*` rows.

notes: Route inventory entries must declare every Phase 6 shared harness as required or n/a.

Socket event inventory enumerates upgrade, hello/resume, presence, record_changed, job_progress, and session_revoked event families. Lifecycle proof is mapped through the socket evidence-index assertion and behavior-level socket tests, not through inventory rows. Route-owned revocation-source coverage is supplemental support evidence, not part of `I-6-01`.

Package-level selector, adapter, and test-utils geometry tests are accounting support evidence, not authoritative Phase 6 row IDs. Paste, fill-down, and group expand/collapse are active FE-P3 support; column resize remains support/design measurement unless an owner spec adopts it.

e2e.title: E-6-03 preserves unsaved local work after socket revocation and re-authentication
e2e.claim: Deterministic route-owned browser revocation sources, including admin revoke-all, current-session logout, and shared-clock idle expiry, emit `session_revoked` on an established browser socket, close that socket, and preserve unsaved local work for explicit recovery and FIFO replay after re-authentication.
e2e.out_of_scope: Browser evidence proves UI preservation and replay after deterministic revocation sources. Concurrency-limit victim selection and socket delivery remain backend and integration evidence rather than browser login-burst evidence.
e2e.default_check_reason: Default browser projection proves cross-stack workflow behavior that lower layers cannot fully exercise.
